# Fixture Repository

A minimal Python repository for Phase 2 tests. Deliberately contains:
- nested functions / inner classes / methods
- absolute, relative (1-level and 2-level), and aliased imports
- a syntax error file (broken_syntax.py)
- ignored dirs: vendor/, node_modules/, .venv/, __pycache__/
- a generated-code file (pkg/generated_code.py)
- a non-module filename (weird-name.py)
